description: This file defines an interface 'ILifecycleObservable' for observable lifecycle stages in the Orleans framework. It includes a method to subscribe observers to lifecycle stages, enabling notification during starting and stopping phases.

classes.name: ILifecycleObservable
classes.description: An interface representing an observable lifecycle, allowing observers to subscribe for notifications on lifecycle stages.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to a specific lifecycle stage for notifications during starting or stopping phases.
